title: Lease a vacancy
summary: Market the space, qualify tenants, negotiate terms and sign the lease.
outlineSteps: Walk the space and list what it needs before it shows
Survey market rents for comparable space on one expense basis
Set the asking rent, term and lease structure
Budget improvements, commissions and free rent
Market the space and track inquiries and tours
Qualify the prospective tenant's operating record and credit
Compare each proposal on net effective rent
Test the deal against the return hurdle and loan coverage
Check the lender's consent rights over new leases
Get the SNDA and update the rent roll
